ModMetaData.name: Actually Textbooks
ModMetaData.author: Gapho
ModMetaData.description:
Textbooks in the classroom make lessons teach more. Higher quality textbooks that are relevant to the lesson make the students learn more at a faster rate and increase the experience the pawn can earn daily before capping. Only a certain number of books can be used before they cap out. Books that are not relevant to the lesson contribute nothing. There are settings to adjust if you want.
Requires Biotech and Progression: Education. Licensed under Unlicense, feel free to steal this IDC.
